{{Quote|Sir. Transmission from Ensign Starsh.|A Chiss informs [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Saganu of Ensign Starsh's call|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Starsh''' was a [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Starsh sent a transmission to the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]] of [[House Miurani]], who was stationed, along with a portion of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]], at [[Zero Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3642 BBY]].
